full_frozen_protocol.execution: Previous close signal, next actual session adjusted open execution. Old holdings earn overnight return before trade; new holdings earn intraday return. Mark close; terminal close liquidation. $100000fractional funded long-only, no leverage/shorts/options, cash0interest.
full_frozen_protocol.cost: 5bps per gross dollar bought/sold; all entry,rebalances,terminalexit. Sensitivity10bps,25bps and one additional executionbar. These are modeled assumptions, not measured fills.
full_frozen_protocol.benchmarks: SameETF buyhold; fixed development meanETF exposure pluszero-interestcash; costs and terminal liquidation included. Exposure benchmark monthly. No alpha claim from simple higherbeta or choosing Nasdaqafterseeingperformance.
full_frozen_protocol.metrics: Original protocol CAGRcalendar, sampleddof1Sharpeagainst0riskfree, alldaysinclcash, drawdownwithinitial100k, netreturn, annualreturns, grossturnover, concentration, exposure. 20-sessionblockbootstrap2000replicates pairedlogexcess, Bonferroni54 explicitlyconservative. full_frozen_protocol.blindness: New-strategy outcomes sequestered. Underlying VOO/QQQM history previously exposed inQORE; no investigatorwide, prospective or genuinelyuntouched data claim.
full_frozen_protocol.whole_share: $2000historical ledger blocked because nominal historical quotes/actiontables unverified. Fractional lot feasibility conditional onbrokersupport; do not infer full$2000whole-shareCAGRfromadjustedprices.

title: core levered confirmation

full_frozen_protocol.universe_rationale: Manageable, broadly liquid US-listed broad equity, sector, defensive Treasury, gold/commodity ETFs plus nine established mega/large-cap stocks and two separately labeled leveraged equity ETFs. Fixed known-today universe; stock selection has survivor and popularity bias. No point-in-time membership or delisted stocks. No inference to all historical stock selection.
full_frozen_protocol.data_source: Public Yahoo Finance chart endpoint: reported OHLCV, adjusted close, dividend/split events and metadata. No credentials or access-denial workaround. Preserve raw bytes, URL, collection UTC and SHA256. Reported OHLC may already be split adjusted; never describe as unadjusted contemporaneous quotes. Validate event/adjustment consistency and reconstruct contemporaneous whole-share quotes from splits.
full_frozen_protocol.walk_forward: Expanding training from 2012, annual validation 2016 through 2023. All 90 fixed configurations evaluated on development; fold champion selected only on prior years, then traded next year, to show adaptive search cost. Final candidates scored on 2016-2023 validation-year returns and stability. No fitting parameters to test slices.
full_frozen_protocol.blindness: Historical new-strategy outcome sequestration only, not investigator-wide or genuinely prospective blindness. Prior QORE ETF history/outcomes may have been inspected. No prior opened holdout is fresh proof. Latest period registered before any outcomes; if not accessible, report unavailable.
full_frozen_protocol.causality: Indicators use trailing adjusted closes only. Close t targets execute at open t+1 (or one additional session in delay stress). Weekly schedule uses Friday close or last session of an ISO week; monthly uses final available session of month, determined without using future market prices. Daily has next-open execution. No same-bar fills. Holdings drift between actual rebalances. No forward fill across missing source quotes, no pre-inception fabricated bars.
full_frozen_protocol.accounting: Fractional-share core $100000 paper account. Mark at adjusted opens, apply post-signal target at next open, hold until next open. Adjusted opens = reported open * adjusted close / reported close; this models source total-return adjustment/reinvestment approximately. Cash earns zero. Long-only, total funded weight <=1. ETF expense/financing effects embedded in fund prices. Terminal liquidation costs included. No extra margin or derivative assumptions.

costs.details: Cost per gross dollar bought/sold, covering modeled spread, slippage and regulatory/fee allowance, zero assumed fixed commission. Assumptions, not observed fills; 2x and 5x scenarios report sensitivity. Entry, rebalances and terminal exit charged.

full_frozen_protocol.small_account: $2000 whole-share simulation with contemporaneous split-reconstructed opens, splits applied to share inventory and gross cash dividend entitlements; reserve transaction cost before buys, no borrowing. Fractional execution viability labeled conditional on broker support; no broker setup.

shortlist.rule: At most one winner per family and eight total. Eligible: positive 2016-2023 net CAGR, >=5 of8 profitable validation years, development max drawdown better than -65% ordinary / -85% leveraged. Score = validation CAGR +0.08*validation Sharpe +0.15*validation max drawdown +0.02*positive_year_fraction. Sort descending; greedy return-correlation <=0.90 to prior choices, with max two stock/high-risk leveraged candidates. Diverse economic profiles retained; thresholds are paper-research screens, not statistical proof.

full_frozen_protocol.benchmarks: SPY and QQQ buy-and-hold; stock equal-weight monthly; 60/40 SPY/IEF monthly; leveraged UPRO/TQQQ buy-and-hold. All next-open same window, costs and terminal exit. Per-shortlist exposure-matched benchmark: fixed development average risky exposure in QQQ for tech/stock/leveraged, SPY otherwise, residual zero-yield cash; leveraged comparator includes same leveraged ETF where relevant. Clearly disclose matching rule.
full_frozen_protocol.metrics: CAGR with calendar elapsed time; total net return; max drawdown including initial equity; annual volatility and Sharpe sqrt(252)*sample mean/sample standard deviation using zero risk-free and all trading sessions incl cash, ddof1. Annual returns, turnover gross buy+sell/equity per year, top holding weight and realized concentration, trade-day frequency.
full_frozen_protocol.uncertainty: 30 designs/90 correlated trials; selected backtests biased upwards. Paired stationary/block bootstrap mean log-return excess versus benchmark, 20-session block,2000 seeded replicates; confidence intervals descriptive. Bonferroni90 significance shown conservatively; lack of formal significance does not veto paper candidates. Stress costs/delay/whole shares/time slices and benchmark context inform confidence.
full_frozen_protocol.release_gate: Coordinator sends protocol/sample metadata and locked shortlist plus hashes to parent before a one-shot code release. Outcome access logged append-only. No later tuning allowed against either test slice. Auditor independently checks chronology, arithmetic, accounting, price/events and key claims before final deliverables.
full_frozen_protocol.deliverables: Every trial and failure, exact code/config/data hashes, source/event metadata, development and test result CSVs, human rules, equity/drawdown plots marked BACKTEST, audit record, reproducibility bundle saved via Library.

outcome_summary: Yahoo429 andStooqchallenge stopped. No outcomes, no fabricated winners, no access-denial workaround. Supplemental54-rule study is a different universe/data contract.
audit_status: Catalog/protocol readable, not an executed study
hypothesis_conclusion: Data availability failure, no evidence for/against any proposed strategy.
valid_retry: A legitimate free source with verified adjustedprices/actions andtiming; freeze newsource/protocol, preserveoriginalunrun status.
untested_data: All strategyoutputs in the27-symbol original grid remain unrun; familiar marketdates are not fresh blind data.

rule_theory: Three profiles beat SPY in both later windows and all nine cost/lag cases in each: relative leverage sleeves, tech trend tiers, and the 45% volatility budget. Relative sleeves returned 149.02% net, 39.41% CAGR, with −37.02% drawdown and 2.01x daily-contract exposure. Only this profile beat its frozen mean-weight control (+2.92 percentage points); its confidence interval includes zero. All six selected CAGRs were below TQQQ 55.36%, UPRO 45.71%, and QLD 42.19% buy-and-hold. A monthly 50% TQQQ/50% QQQ control returned 41.62% CAGR with −42.32% drawdown. Ladder, stop35, and confirmed rotation disappointed. No drawdown veto was imposed. Versions 1/2 contain the same experiment/results; version 2 clarifies carried annual ledgers versus fresh 2026 windows.

full_frozen_protocol.scope: Exploratory Composer-style long-only stock/ETF research. No live trading, orders, accounts, paid data or runtime changes.
full_frozen_protocol.universe_rationale: Manageable, broadly liquid US-listed broad equity, sector, defensive Treasury, gold/commodity ETFs plus nine established mega/large-cap stocks and two separately labeled leveraged equity ETFs. Fixed known-today universe; stock selection has survivor and popularity bias. No point-in-time membership or delisted stocks. No inference to all historical stock selection.
full_frozen_protocol.data_source: Public Yahoo Finance chart endpoint: reported OHLCV, adjusted close, dividend/split events and metadata. No credentials or access-denial workaround. Preserve raw bytes, URL, collection UTC and SHA256. Reported OHLC may already be split adjusted; never describe as unadjusted contemporaneous quotes. Validate event/adjustment consistency and reconstruct contemporaneous whole-share quotes from splits.
full_frozen_protocol.walk_forward: Expanding training from 2012, annual validation 2016 through 2023. All 90 fixed configurations evaluated on development; fold champion selected only on prior years, then traded next year, to show adaptive search cost. Final candidates scored on 2016-2023 validation-year returns and stability. No fitting parameters to test slices.
full_frozen_protocol.blindness: Historical new-strategy outcome sequestration only, not investigator-wide or genuinely prospective blindness. Prior QORE ETF history/outcomes may have been inspected. No prior opened holdout is fresh proof. Latest period registered before any outcomes; if not accessible, report unavailable.
full_frozen_protocol.causality: Indicators use trailing adjusted closes only. Close t targets execute at open t+1 (or one additional session in delay stress). Weekly schedule uses Friday close or last session of an ISO week; monthly uses final available session of month, determined without using future market prices. Daily has next-open execution. No same-bar fills. Holdings drift between actual rebalances. No forward fill across missing source quotes, no pre-inception fabricated bars.
full_frozen_protocol.accounting: Fractional-share core $100000 paper account. Mark at adjusted opens, apply post-signal target at next open, hold until next open. Adjusted opens = reported open * adjusted close / reported close; this models source total-return adjustment/reinvestment approximately. Cash earns zero. Long-only, total funded weight <=1. ETF expense/financing effects embedded in fund prices. Terminal liquidation costs included. No extra margin or derivative assumptions.

costs.details: Cost per gross dollar bought/sold, covering modeled spread, slippage and regulatory/fee allowance, zero assumed fixed commission. Assumptions, not observed fills; 2x and 5x scenarios report sensitivity. Entry, rebalances and terminal exit charged.

full_frozen_protocol.small_account: $2000 whole-share simulation with contemporaneous split-reconstructed opens, splits applied to share inventory and gross cash dividend entitlements; reserve transaction cost before buys, no borrowing. Fractional execution viability labeled conditional on broker support; no broker setup.

shortlist.rule: At most one winner per family and eight total. Eligible: positive 2016-2023 net CAGR, >=5 of8 profitable validation years, development max drawdown better than -65% ordinary / -85% leveraged. Score = validation CAGR +0.08*validation Sharpe +0.15*validation max drawdown +0.02*positive_year_fraction. Sort descending; greedy return-correlation <=0.90 to prior choices, with max two stock/high-risk leveraged candidates. Diverse economic profiles retained; thresholds are paper-research screens, not statistical proof.

full_frozen_protocol.benchmarks: SPY and QQQ buy-and-hold; stock equal-weight monthly; 60/40 SPY/IEF monthly; leveraged UPRO/TQQQ buy-and-hold. All next-open same window, costs and terminal exit. Per-shortlist exposure-matched benchmark: fixed development average risky exposure in QQQ for tech/stock/leveraged, SPY otherwise, residual zero-yield cash; leveraged comparator includes same leveraged ETF where relevant. Clearly disclose matching rule.
full_frozen_protocol.metrics: CAGR with calendar elapsed time; total net return; max drawdown including initial equity; annual volatility and Sharpe sqrt(252)*sample mean/sample standard deviation using zero risk-free and all trading sessions incl cash, ddof1. Annual returns, turnover gross buy+sell/equity per year, top holding weight and realized concentration, trade-day frequency.
full_frozen_protocol.uncertainty: 30 designs/90 correlated trials; selected backtests biased upwards. Paired stationary/block bootstrap mean log-return excess versus benchmark, 20-session block,2000 seeded replicates; confidence intervals descriptive. Bonferroni90 significance shown conservatively; lack of formal significance does not veto paper candidates. Stress costs/delay/whole shares/time slices and benchmark context inform confidence.
full_frozen_protocol.release_gate: Coordinator sends protocol/sample metadata and locked shortlist plus hashes to parent before a one-shot code release. Outcome access logged append-only. No later tuning allowed against either test slice. Auditor independently checks chronology, arithmetic, accounting, price/events and key claims before final deliverables.
full_frozen_protocol.deliverables: Every trial and failure, exact code/config/data hashes, source/event metadata, development and test result CSVs, human rules, equity/drawdown plots marked BACKTEST, audit record, reproducibility bundle saved via Library.

full_frozen_protocol.causality: Indicators use trailing adjusted closes only. Close t targets execute at open t+1 (or one additional session in delay stress). Weekly schedule uses Friday close or last session of an ISO week; monthly uses final available session of month, determined without using future market prices. Daily has next-open execution. No same-bar fills. Holdings drift between actual rebalances. No forward fill across missing source quotes, no pre-inception fabricated bars.
full_frozen_protocol.accounting: Fractional-share core $100000 paper account. Mark at adjusted opens, apply post-signal target at next open, hold until next open. Adjusted opens = reported open * adjusted close / reported close; this models source total-return adjustment/reinvestment approximately. Cash earns zero. Long-only, total funded weight <=1. ETF expense/financing effects embedded in fund prices. Terminal liquidation costs included. No extra margin or derivative assumptions.

costs.details: Cost per gross dollar bought/sold, covering modeled spread, slippage and regulatory/fee allowance, zero assumed fixed commission. Assumptions, not observed fills; 2x and 5x scenarios report sensitivity. Entry, rebalances and terminal exit charged.

shortlist.rule: At most one winner per family and eight total. title: Two funded NAV relationship experiments

full_frozen_protocol.universe_rationale: Fixed economically linked ETFs already in audited issuer NAV data, with Brent external feature. No ticker optimization. Known-today choices and reused historical regimes are exploratory.
full_frozen_protocol.common_math: Daily log total-NAV returns. At each flat signal date, fit centered return sensitivities with nonnegative slopes and intercept on 252 prior valid equity observations ending BEFORE the 20-observation dislocation window. Enumerate the four active subsets of the two slopes, least squares on centered data, reject negative slopes, choose minimum SSE with deterministic subset tie-break. Alert z=(sum last20 residual log returns)/(training residual sampleSD*sqrt20); sigma must be positive and model rank valid. This standardized alert is not a cointegration or Gaussian guarantee. No window, z or holding-time search.
full_frozen_protocol.XLE_residual: Model XLE versus SPY and log change in the latest Brent observation available under the frozen 8-calendar-day publication convention. Flat baseline SPY; if z<=-2, command 100%XLE at next observed NAV. Freeze entry coefficients/intercept/sigma. Exit to SPY when the rolling20 residual under the fixed entry fit reaches z>=0, or after20 actual close-to-close holding intervals. Never short oil orSPY. No residual stop tuning.
full_frozen_protocol.IEF_barbell: Model IEF versus SHY/TLT returns with the same prior252/20 math. Flat baseline SHY. At z<=-2, command100%IEF (cheap belly). At z>=2, command a funded SHY/TLT barbell proportional to the two nonnegative entry slopes, provided their sum>0 (cheap barbell). Freeze coefficients/intercept/sigma and barbell weights. Exit to SHY on residual reachingzero from its entry side, or after20 close-to-close intervals. This normalized funding proxy differs from an exact long/short hedge, and intercept/normalization error is disclosed.
full_frozen_protocol.timing: All NAV-derived signals at close execute NEXT observed equity NAV close; old holdings earn the interval into execution, new holdings earn the following interval. Entry/exit ages reference scheduled baseline execution dates. Extra0/1/2 execution lags stress frozen signal states rather than a broker-fill-feedback model.
full_frozen_protocol.Brent_availability: Official EIA observations are released weekly, not contemporaneously daily. Primary observation_date+8 calendar days is a predeclared exploratory availability convention, not verified original historical timestamps/vintages. A separately labeled15-day lag is a source-availability stress, not a new selectable rule. Join latest actually available observation; no future backfill. Raw source and current release metadata retained. Future research requires actual timestamped releases.

At each flat signal date, fit centered return sensitivities with nonnegative slopes and intercept on 252 prior valid equity observations ending BEFORE the 20-observation dislocation window. title: Curve carry and rolldown per funded dollar-duration

hypothesis.name: Curve carry and rolldown per funded dollar-duration
hypothesis.mechanism: A steep Treasury segment can compensate a funded duration holder through yield carry and the price effect of aging toward a lower-yield maturity. Compare intermediate and long maturity on the same approximate dollar-duration budget rather than choosing more rate beta. This is curve compensation research, not arbitrage or a causal term-premium identification.
hypothesis.proxy_limit: Treasury par-curve yields are not ETF yield-to-maturity or zero-coupon forwards; IEF/TLT are portfolios that rebalance instead of a single aging bond. Fixed maturity/duration approximations omit convexity, composition, tracking, fees and changing actual duration. These are explicit paper-research model assumptions, never ETF cash payments or exchange fills.
hypothesis.formula: For ETF j, annual carry+1y rolldown approximation c_j=y(M_j)/100 + D_j*(y(M_j)-y(M_j-1))/100. Dollar-duration-normalized score s_j=c_j/D_j. Linear interpolation only inside retained observed nodes. Strict s_TLT>s_IEF chooses TLT; tie chooses IEF. No fitted parameter or threshold search.
hypothesis.information_contract: Current-vintage official Treasury observations; at month first XNYS sessionD use newest full-node observation dated<=D-2 XNYS snapshot, no future backfill; maximum7 calendar days old. Missing/stale curve parks that monthly action and retains previous holdings with a flagged gap; no automatic information-based fallback. Initial missing curve blocks the book. Source processing updated timestamps are not original publication proof.
hypothesis.one_year_roll_horizon: Mathematical annual score only, not a forecast of guaranteed1y ETF return or realized holding horizon.

title: Slow crypto liquidity-risk compensation
hypothesis: When a persistent unsigned price-movement-per-USDT-turnover state is high relative to its own earlier history, investors may require greater forward compensation for bearing liquidity risk. A fully funded month-scale spot allocation in that state may improve net return or exceptional risk performance. Persistent illiquidity may instead produce adverse selection, higher costs, structural decline and losses.

title: SPY monthly option-expiry hedge-reset week

hypothesis.name: Standard option-expiration week SPY hedge-reset demand
hypothesis.statement: As standard monthly equity options approach expiration, closing or rolling customer exposures can reduce short-stock hedges and cause buying pressure. A fully funded SPY long in the scheduled expiration calendar week may earn a reduced-form premium.
hypothesis.observable: Scheduled standard monthly expiration calendar only
hypothesis.conditional_explanation: Unobserved hedge holdings can have either sign. The calendar does not identify gamma, strike attraction, positions or dealer flow. Profitable timing would not establish the mechanism.

theory_sources.title: Returns and option activity over the option-expiration week for S&P 100 stocks
theory_sources.support: Author-university reproduction of the published abstract proposes reduced short-stock hedge positions and declining perceived risk as possible contributors to third-Friday-week stock-return patterns.
theory_sources.limit: Abstract-only qualification. Findings concern S&P100 stocks, not this SPY funded implementation. Net option positions, gamma, strikes, implied volatility and causal flow are unavailable here.

theory_sources.title: Rules of Cboe Exchange, Inc., updated December24,2018, Rule1.1(mmm)
theory_sources.support: For standard options after February1,2015 the calendar is third Friday, with closed-Friday expiration moved to the preceding open exchange day.
theory_sources.limit: Current reproduction of an archived rulebook, not a historical option-chain census. Grandfathered exceptions and other nonstandard series are not modeled. This clock selects standard monthly weeks only.

theory_sources.limit: Current rulebook corroboration is not a PIT record.

title: MSFT customer-contract coverage expansion

hypothesis.title: MSFT customer-contract coverage expansion
hypothesis.mechanism: Expanded unearned recognition obligations relative to same-season recognized revenue may reveal stronger recurring contractual demand before full income-statement recognition. Invoiced unearned revenue is not assumed to be received cash or unconditional backlog.
hypothesis.falsifier: No after-cost advantage versus owning the same issuer; fragile cost/clock/entitlement assumptions; repeated source breaks or changes in contract mix explain the apparent relation.

implementation.definition: U = literal short-term unearned revenue + literal long-term unearned revenue. R = literal same-fiscal-year YTD consolidated revenue. Compare U/R with the prior same-fiscal-quarter ORIGINAL U/R, with matching 3/6/9/12-month duration, recorded basis and source compatibility. Current-file prior comparative must equal earlier original R. Reject nonpositive R or negative U. No annualization, TTM/OCF/NI/accrual/market-cap/debt/buyback feature.
implementation.threshold_policy: Both strict zero change signs are theory fixed before feature computation; no threshold grid or respecification.
implementation.positions: One owned long lot at most. Freeze intended quantity from the BASE book at original decision CLOSE: q = floor_to_0.000001[(0.90 * spendable cash - $1)/(decision nominal CLOSE * 1.0005)]. The fixed 10% opening gap/funding reserve and rounding residual remain cash. All four cases retain the original BASE quantity intention; alternate costs/delays cannot rescale it. If execution is unfunded or an earlier delayed lot prevents entry, preserve the rejected intent and fail that path; no resize/retry. No shorts, margin, leverage, topups or repeat active-lot triggers. Ignore an event on the same decision close as an exit; fresh later events only.
implementation.timing: Decision at first complete session CLOSE whose OPEN was strictly after all current/prior source acceptance. Entry next available source session OPEN plus case-specific delay. Natural scheduled exit after 63 base-entry OPEN-to-OPEN intervals; delayed case shifts both buy and exit references one session, retaining original information and quantity intentions. Information events and quantity intents are frozen by BASE before stress replay. Missing source prices fail the case; no forwardfill or fabricated liquidation.
implementation.source_missing_policy: Preserve every slot and failed pair. Source incompatibility blocks that event before predicate evaluation and does not equal a false signal.

accounting.costs: Adverse reference fill and fixed ticket charged on every nonzero symbol/side including initial/terminal; no fee-free netting.
accounting.dividends: Twenty actual issuer cash rows. Modeled ex date is record date minus two actual XNYS sessions before 2017-09-05 and minus one after. All four cases share this regime-aware convention; no extra entitlement paths. Missing original ex dates and unusual issuer exceptions remain residual assumptions. Receivables stay unspendable until second actual-session CLOSE strictly after payment date, fundable following OPEN.
accounting.sale_settlement: Trades before 2017-09-05 accrue net proceeds as unspendable T+3 session receivables; trades on/after use T+2. Credit at settlement CLOSE and fund only following OPEN. Delayed sale uses its actual trade date for regime/calendar. Unsettled net proceeds count in economic NAV and cross phase boundaries; private posting remains unqualified.
accounting.fixed_lot_assumption: 0.000001 fractional nominal owned-share quantum; any positive quantum permitted by hypotheticalmodel. No actual broker minimum/rounding/settlement certification. Report intended/executed/rejected shares and gross exposures.
accounting.volume: Report source volume/notional participation diagnostics after launch; no universal volume hard cap or result-responsive resizing.
accounting.actions: Bounded stable MSFT ordinary-share/no identified compulsory split model. Any newly identified compulsory action requires source-contract review before launch/replay; never infer action cash from raw/all differences.

primary_benchmark: Persistent 90%-intended MSFT ownership: first BASE intent at 2016-01-04 CLOSE, next-session OPEN entry, same 0.000001-share rounding/$1 ticket/adverse fill, with fixed original BASE quantity intentions retained in each delay/cost case. Carries continuously and sells at scheduled 2020-12-30 CLOSE or delayed 2020-12-31 CLOSE; same actual dividend/action/settlement convention. No signal, topups or reinvestment; isolates information timing from issuer beta.
